name: bidragskoll
description: Bidragskoll.se — funding discovery, eligibility, application and case-management platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w apps/api -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core -w apps/api -w apps/web
scripts.demo:check: node demo/checks/check.mjs && node demo/checks/bizcheck.mjs && node demo/checks/backcheck.mjs && node demo/checks/savecheck.mjs && node demo/checks/alderscheck.mjs && node demo/checks/lankcheck.mjs && node demo/checks/forberedcheck.mjs && node demo/checks/kontocheck.mjs && node demo/checks/vidarecheck.mjs && node demo/checks/ctxcheck.mjs
scripts.verify:ui: node tools/uicheck/uicheck2.mjs && node tools/uicheck/uicheck8.mjs && node tools/uicheck/uicheck9.mjs && node tools/uicheck/uicheck12.mjs && node tools/uicheck/uicheck13.mjs && node tools/uicheck/uicheck14.mjs
scripts.seo:check: node --experimental-strip-types tools/genseo.mjs && node tools/seocheck.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/schemacheck-seo.mjs
